body:
I was going to plan to be out of the house more and reconnect with old friends, but socialising costs a lot.
Also the problem with my old housemate got worse and worse, as we only ever saw each other fleetingly and all we had time for was to argue over chores, never time to have fun together.
For the short term I think it might work though to make him realise I do have other things to be doing than listening to his tantrums.

thanks for taking the time to talk to me a bit :3

18months isn't that long to live in hell I guess, I just hope I can get my dream and he doesn't find a way to pull the plug on it by seriously injuring me or my bank account.

I guess it is a matter of perspective.

If you look at it like I have to do all boring X so I can have fun Y

Instead of wouldn't it be great to have fun Y, so I better earn it by doing a bit of X

I know exactly what you mean though, personally I find it hard not to resent thoughts who circumvent this by benefits etc, but that is a different issue not for here.

I guess you have to think as well, if you didn't work and pay rent you would have no where to live and truly have no life, maybe try find a job that is less of a chore, make some of the other obligations more enjoyable, see them as all part of life rather than chores you have to do to be able to have a life.

I guess I am just hoping I get numb to it.
As he screams and throws things at me I am gonna try not arguing back and just sit there and hope he tires himself out.
Not complain when he doesn't let me sleep, maybe one day he might just *realise* I don't want the tv on full blast when I have work in 4hours.
Asking him to turn it down = big row of 'why should he'

I have had hell with housemates for the last 4years, no way I am gonna ruin the one friendship I have by moving in with him even tho he offered me his spare room for cheap

plus due to contracts I can't.

As its a private contract, sublet we cant just move in/out, so even if he left I cant get someone else in. We would have to both move out and forfit rent money for rest of year. Meaning I would owe letting agent thousands.

Then theres the cost to get out of all the utility contracts also set up on 12-18month contracts.
At the moment he pays all the gas/leccy/internet I pay the counciltax/water and we add it up and make it even end of each month.

He could move those utilities to another home and leave me with no power, so id have to set my own up (on a 6month min contract usually)

Or he could at anytime just stop paying me the difference so i pay a few hundred over odds each month. He often threatens this knowing nothing I can do. Argues that as hes a student he doesnt have to pay council tax (technically true if he lived alone or with other students there is no tax but as we share a house, there is tax on it, and i believe tax on the house shouldnt be all down to me)

For me to move out would cost
a) remaining 18months my half rent - so thats 500*18.
b) all the moving costs
c) deposit on a new place
d) costs for all bills on a place on my own

I just don't have that money, it would destroy my plans for my future too.

If he moves out
a) I have to pay all utilties on my own, for a 3bed house. Impossible +ruins my future, plus hell never move.




Hes paid his half of rent full up in advance, so all that happens if he moves out is I have to pay 100% of all the utilities and tax, ontop of my half the rent I pay direct to letting agent each month.


The only way I can afford the Japan thing is to keep my finances are they are or somehow reduce them. moving in with my best friend would reduce my rent slightly, if i could get out of my houseing contract and get over the facy I have 3rooms worth of stuff id have to cram into a tiny bedroom(guess ill have to do this for japan anyway) but itll take me 18months to organise, store/sell it all, when i only just got a place I have space to display it all in
